en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a street scene with several multi-storey buildings in a small town. The main focus is a large, prominent post office building with a hipped roof and small tower-like structure on top, along with an arched entranceway leading into a courtyard. Two people stand in the street in front of the gate. The architecture appears early 20th-century Central European. Printed text at the top identifies the location as Grünhainichen in the Erzgebirge and indicates that the building is the imperial post office.
